android17: Seventeen, don't get in my way.

passive.name: Cyborg Pulse
passive.description: Android 18's third basic attack gains 125% bonus attack speed, which has an uncancellable windup, and deals 130% AD (+ 30% AP) magic damage to the primary target and 40% AD (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies. It deals 150% damage to monsters, and executes minions that are secondary targets and would be left below 25 health. Hidden Passive: for 4.5 seconds she gains +5% Attack Damage, +5% Attack Speed and +5% Movement Speed every time Krillin, as an ally, gets injured. She also gains an extra bounty for killing Dr. Gero.

effects.minionExecute: Secondary targets that would be left below 25 health

effects.bounty: Extra bounty for killing Dr. Gero

h1.name: Energy Strike
h1.description: Android 18 blasts an energy bolt in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

effects.note: Hits first two enemies in the direction

h2.name: Energy Shield
h2.description: Android 18 grants herself a shield for up to 5 seconds and creates three spheres that orbit her counterclockwise for the same duration, detonating upon contact with an enemy to deal magic damage to nearby enemies. If all three spheres detonate, Energy Shield is reapplied, stacking with its original shield and refreshing the duration.

effects.note: Detonation of all 3 orbs reapplies and stacks shield

h3.name: Cyborg Dash
h3.description: Android 18 dashes in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies near the landing location. She grants ghosting to non-champions she passes through for 4 seconds. She stops prematurely upon colliding with an enemy champion, knocking back all nearby enemy champions, though not through terrain, as well as stunning them for 0.75 seconds, while also gaining bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.

h4.name: Master Martial
h4.description: Android 18 overclocks her cybernetic core for a duration, entering an empowered state and becoming ghosted. She can refresh the duration of her Master Martial buff whenever she scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them.

effects.refreshOnKill: Refreshes duration on takedown within 3 seconds of damaging enemy champion

lore:
Android 18, originally a human named Lazuli, was transformed into a powerful cyborg by Dr. Gero of the Red Ribbon Army. Alongside her twin brother, Android 17, she was created to eliminate Goku, though both siblings retained free will and defied their creator. Calm, confident, and sharp-tongued, 18 possesses immense strength, durability, and speed that rival the strongest fighters in the universe. Despite her cold exterior, she shows a protective and caring side, especially toward Krillin, whom she eventually marries.

Her combat style blends precision and relentless power, enhanced by her ability to channel energy blasts and withstand damage far beyond normal limits. 18's pragmatic nature makes her an efficient and strategic fighter, unshaken even in the face of overwhelming opponents. She is defined by her independence and loyalty to those she chooses to protect, standing as both a fearsome warrior and a devoted ally.
